name: ecoplaca-monorepo
description: Monorepo fullstack para EcoPlaca - Gestión circular y trazabilidad de RAEE

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db

author: EcoPlaca Team
